services.title: Software Development Services
services.subtitle: From concept to a product in operation, we design, build and evolve the software your business runs on. Every project is led by experienced engineers and delivers production-ready code from the first release.

items.title: Custom Software Development
items.desc: Full-stack applications built around your business rules, from internal tools to customer-facing platforms. We handle architecture, database design, APIs and interfaces, with scalability and long-term maintainability in mind.

items.title: Web Development
items.desc: Fast, responsive websites and web applications built with Angular and React. Every page is optimized for performance, conversion and search visibility.

items.title: Mobile App Development
items.desc: Native and cross-platform iOS and Android apps focused on performance and user experience. We support the full lifecycle, from prototype to App Store and Google Play release.

items.title: Dedicated Development Teams
items.desc: Engineers integrated into your team on a flexible monthly contract, with no recruiting process and no long-term commitment. Capacity follows your roadmap.

items.title: UX/UI Design
items.desc: User research, wireframes and interface design that make complex products simple to use. We design in Figma, validate with real users and deliver components ready for implementation.

items.title: Integrations & Modernization
items.desc: Integration between your CRM, payment gateways, ERP and third-party systems, and migration of legacy platforms to modern architectures without interrupting operations.

portfolio.cta: Want something like this for your business?

items.name: Opportunity
items.desc: A payment request and approval platform built natively on SAP Business One and SAP C4C. Teams submit payment requests with invoices attached, route them through multi-level approval workflows by spending authority, and see everything post straight to SAP — no spreadsheets, no manual re-entry, full audit trail.

items.name: JuriOne
items.desc: A complete legal practice management platform with AI built in — automated petition drafting, case and deadline tracking, client and contract management, and billing, all in one system. Law firms using JuriOne report saving up to 4 hours a day that used to go into manual paperwork.

items.name: Upsee
items.desc: A computer vision platform that turns in-store cameras into real-time analytics — foot traffic, visitor demographics, and conversion metrics — giving retail chains the same data insight e-commerce stores have had for years.

sapTeaser.title: SAP & CRM Customization
sapTeaser.subtitle: SAP Business One and CRM systems hold everything your company needs — but weren't built for a quick, everyday look at what matters.
sapTeaser.desc: We build a customization layer on top of your existing SAP Business One and CRM (C4C) data, so your team can consult reports, payments, clients, and projects without digging through menus or exporting spreadsheets. Every implementation starts from Opportunity, our own production-tested platform, and is then tailored to your company's specific workflows, approval rules, and branding.

faq.title: Before you get in touch, you may want to know:

items.q: How does the WA Coders nearshore model work?
items.a: We have offices in Miami and São Paulo and work in your company’s time zone, whether in the U.S., Europe or Brazil. Collaboration happens in real time, with fluent English communication and documentation at every stage.

items.q: What services does WA Coders offer?
items.a: Custom software development, web development, mobile apps (iOS and Android), dedicated teams, UX/UI design, integrations and legacy modernization, and SAP Business One and CRM C4C customization.

items.q: Do you implement AI, chatbots and RAG?
items.a: Yes. We design and integrate artificial intelligence solutions, such as chatbots, virtual assistants and RAG (retrieval-augmented generation), connected to your company’s documents, databases and systems, such as CRM and ERP.

items.q: Which technologies do you work with?
items.a: Angular, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, Java, .NET, React Native, Flutter, Swift, Android, MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, WordPress and Figma, plus SAP Business One/C4C, Microsoft Dynamics 365 and AI models such as Claude (Anthropic) and GPT (OpenAI).

items.q: How does hiring a dedicated team work?
items.a: Engineers join your team on a flexible monthly contract, with no recruiting process and no long-term commitment. Capacity scales up or down as your roadmap changes.

items.q: How do I request a proposal, and how fast do you reply?
items.a: Fill out the contact form. We reply within 24 hours, learn about your business, discuss team structure, timeline and budget and, within days, finalize the project specifications.

items.q: Do you customize SAP Business One and CRM C4C?
items.a: Yes. We build a customization layer on top of your SAP Business One and CRM C4C data, starting from Opportunity, our production-proven platform, and tailored to your approval workflows, rules and branding.
